label: Hermes
summary: Harness-first, strict guardrails, explicit local/global separation, anti-hallucination, artifacts and ownership.
claim_notes: Hermes policy is an adapter hypothesis for guarded local/global task orchestration.
failure_modes: Local and global synthesis boundaries blur
Unsupported claims are smoothed into final prose
Ownership conflicts are not resolved explicitly
rules: Separate harness policy from task facts.
Keep local extraction separate from global synthesis.
Mark unsupported claims instead of smoothing over gaps.
Use strict guardrails for file, source, and evidence boundaries.
verification_gates: Local and global work are separated
